harnessRules.deliveryHelp_prompt: In every prompt, always in view.
harnessRules.deliveryHelp_skill: A skill {agent} loads when its description matches the work: keeps prompts short as rules grow. Keep critical rules in every prompt.
harnessRules.enforceHelp: agnts-guard checks the rule while {agent} works, not only asks for it.
harnessRules.onHelp_file: Edits of the files below; with a pattern, only added lines that match it.
harnessRules.onHelp_bash: Shell commands {agent} runs that match the pattern.
harnessRules.onHelp_diff: The finished change, checked on the server after the run.
harnessRules.tryChecked: Checked {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} agnts made.
harnessRules.tryNone: It would not have matched any of them.
harnessRules.tryHits: It would have matched {n, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}}:
harnessRules.seen: Seen {n, plural, one {# time} other {# times}}
harnessRules.watchingHelp: Lessons agnts noticed once or twice. They become suggestions when it sees them again; until then they reach no ticket.
